name: DraggableItem
src_typeComment: Reusable draggable UI item — not tied to any one specific system (inventory, kiosk menu, puzzle piece). Drops onto whichever DropZone is under the pointer on release, if any accepts it; otherwise snaps back to where it started. Reparents to the root Canvas while dragging so it draws on top of any sibling UI.

src_serialized.name: itemTag
src_serialized.tooltip: Optional tag a DropZone can filter on via its acceptedTags list. Leave blank to be accepted everywhere unfiltered.

src_serialized.name: draggingAlpha
src_serialized.tooltip: CanvasGroup alpha while being dragged, so it visually reads as 'lifted'.

src_members.name: UnityEvent
src_members.comment: Fires on every drag end — with the DropZone it landed on, or null if it snapped back to origin.

src_members.name: ReturnToOrigin
src_members.comment: Public so a DropZone (or anything else) can send this item back where it came from — e.g. a zone that turns out to be full and rejects the drop after accepting the raycast hit.
